title: Counting quanta and measuring their exchange
caption: The two preparations give the same probabilities for both count outcomes. Measuring the exchange on fresh preparations gives +1 for the sum and −1 for the difference, each with certainty.
accessible_description: Two columns show the sum and difference preparations. In each column, two quanta in the first harmonic and none in the second occur with probability one half. None in the first harmonic and one in the second also occur with probability one half. A different instrument measures the operation that exchanges these alternatives, using freshly prepared states. Its result is always plus one for the sum and always minus one for the difference.
